subject: Cloud operator onboarding addendum and operator roster clarifications
messages:
From: Jennifer Cole <jennifer.cole@aerobank.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudNova Procurement <procure@cloudnova.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarification: operator roster & onboarding exceptions for AeroBank RFP

Hi Grace / Laura,

Thanks again for the response to our RFP. A few follow-ups from our vendor security team while we finalize the third-party attestation:

1) Can you confirm the complete list of cloud operator entities (including downstream operator teams / contractors) that may have access to customer KV caches or orchestration controls for AeroBank's tenant? We need legal names, hosting region, and whether they are employees vs contractors.

2) AeroBank's policy requires documented onboarding exceptions for any operator that will not be covered by our standard SSO + SAML onboarding. Do you have a template addendum we can review?

3) We also need KMS architecture details showing who holds custodial keys for customer-specific encryption (even if keys are customer-managed). A diagram would be ideal.

Can you send a roster and any draft addendum by end of day Friday? We may loop legal (cc'd Michelle Lee) for contract language.

Appreciate it — we want to keep the path to procurement moving.

Best,
Jennifer
Jennifer Cole
Sr. Director, Vendor Risk
AeroBank

Attachments: AeroBank_RFI_questions.xlsx (referenced)

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jennifer Cole <jennifer.cole@aerobank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification: operator roster & onboarding exceptions for AeroBank RFP

Hi Jennifer — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up-front and a bundle attached:

- Operator roster: see attached redwood_operator_roster_v2.pdf. It enumerates internal teams and third-party operator suppliers (CloudNova for edge ops; NeoOps for on-prem install support). Each entry includes legal entity, primary country of operation, and employee vs contractor flag.

- Onboarding addendum: attached is a draft operator onboarding addendum (operator-onboarding-addendum-draft.docx). It covers SSO/SAML exceptions, required attestations, and controls to be included in the procurement schedule.

- KMS / key custody: high-level diagram attached (kms-architecture-diagram.png). For hosted customers we retain no plaintext tenant keys; we provide a customer-managed KMS option and an Redwood-managed envelope encryption option. The diagram shows who has access to wrap/unwrap operations and the separation between control-plane and data-plane services.

Proposed next steps:
- If the attachments look good, can we schedule a 30-min call Thursday (7/12) to walk through the addendum clauses and signoff items?
- For anything that requires legal redlines we can prepare tracked changes and return within 48 hours.

Looping in Rishi for SOC/assurance confirmations below.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Go-to-Market Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_operator_roster_v2.pdf; operator-onboarding-addendum-draft.docx; kms-architecture-diagram.png

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jennifer Cole <jennifer.cole@aerobank.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Clarification: operator roster & onboarding exceptions for AeroBank RFP

Jennifer — forwarding Grace's bundle plus a couple procurement notes below.

On Wed, Jul 11, 2028 at 11:05 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message and attachments)

Procurement notes from our side:
- We typically accept a single onboarding addendum appended to the Master Services Agreement. The draft Grace provided maps to common AeroBank controls; we can tighten the SSO proofing language if AeroBank requires explicit MFA enforcement for operator break-glass accounts.
- Please confirm whether AeroBank will require background checks for contractor personnel from the third-party operator roster (CloudNova / NeoOps). If so, we'll annotate the roster entries where checks are not currently performed.

Stephanie — can you run a quick check on any outstanding region exclusions for the suppliers listed in the roster and confirm whether CloudNova runs any EU-based operator pods that might handle EU customer tenants?

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification: operator roster & onboarding exceptions for AeroBank RFP

Laura / Grace — quick follow-up after checking supplier region footprints:

- CloudNova: primary operations US (us-east, us-west). They do run a small support pod in the EU to support EMEA customers; however, that pod is strictly limited to telemetry ingestion and support tooling (no KV cache access). We flagged CloudNova entry in the roster with a note: "EU support pod: telemetry-only, no KV/control-plane access."
- NeoOps: US-only contractors; background checks performed for full-time employees but not for short-term contractors.

Rishi — please confirm SOC2 / ISO coverage for CloudNova and NeoOps. If we don't have a current attestation on file, we should request one before final procurement.

-Stephanie

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jennifer Cole <jennifer.cole@aerobank.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification: operator roster & onboarding exceptions for AeroBank RFP

Hi Jennifer — confirming a couple of assurance points so your team has them for procurement: 

- Redwood SOC 2 Type II covers our hosted control-plane and operator procedures; we can share the current report under NDA.
- CloudNova: we have a current SOC 2 report on file (shared under NDA previously). NeoOps: currently ISO 27001 certified for employees; contractors have transitional coverage — we will request the latest SOC attestations and share with you.

Regarding the addendum: the draft looks operationally aligned. For background-check requirements we can add an Exhibit that requires supplier-supplied evidence; however, if AeroBank requires Redwood to police each contractor directly, that becomes operationally expensive and we should discuss a risk-accepted path with procurement/legal.

Jennifer — if that works, Grace and I can prepare a tracked-change markup of the addendum and upload a DocuSign-ready version. I've also uploaded the operator roster and diagram to the HubSpot deal record (link below).

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-8742

On Fri, Jul 13, 2028 at 09:15 AM Jennifer Cole <jennifer.cole@aerobank.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the attachments. We'll review and get back with any redlines.
>
> - Jennifer

From: Jennifer Cole <jennifer.cole@aerobank.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Michelle Lee <michelle.lee@lawfirm.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jul 2028 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification: operator roster & onboarding exceptions for AeroBank RFP

Grace / team — got everything you shared, and thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of final items before procurement will greenlight the award:

- Please upload the final tracked-change addendum and send a DocuSign link for execution.
- AeroBank requires supplier attestations for contractor background checks OR a signed acceptance of residual risk by AeroBank security leadership. We'll aim to get that signed if Redwood cannot provide signed background-check evidence for NeoOps contractors.
- Can we set the 30-min call Monday 7/16 at 10:00 AM ET to walk through the addendum?

I'll share any redlines from legal (Michelle) before the call.

Best,
Jennifer

Attachments: AeroBank_next_steps.pdf (internal)
